brief.summary: An internal search tool built by the QA tools team at a large game studio so testers can find existing bug reports that match what they just saw before filing a new one.
brief.user: Aaliyah Brooks, a QA tester on the console certification team for an open-world co-op game. She files about 15 bugs a day and is measured partly on her duplicate rate.
brief.moment: During a four-player co-op session on build 0.48.2117 she hit a crash: opening the world map during a rainstorm while a teammate was fast-traveling. She has the crash dump ID and a 40-second clip. Before filing, she describes it in her own words and wants likely matches back. Some candidates are the same crash under different wording, some are similar map crashes fixed two builds ago, and some may be a regression. brief.data: Bug database for the title: 48,600 reports, 3,940 open. Her description: 'crash opening map in rain co-op teammate fast travel PS5'. Crash signature from the dump: MapRenderer::UpdateWeatherOverlay null pointer. Candidate reports carry ID, title, status (open, fixed, closed-can't-reproduce, duplicate), platform (PS5, Xbox Series, PC), first and last build seen, crash signature if any, number of linked duplicates, reporter, assigned team, severity (S1–S4) and attached clips. Notable candidates: GW-31877 'Map crash during storms' (fixed in 0.47.2090, same signature, 12 duplicates); GW-33402 'Client freeze when host fast travels while map open' (open, PC only, no signature); GW-33519 'Weather overlay flicker on map' (open, S4, no crash). Also 14 other reports since build 0.46 mention 'map' and 'rain'. Her session: tester ID QA-0217, devkit PS5-DK-44.

prompt:
I need the front end for Dupehound. An internal search tool built by the QA tools team at a large game studio so testers can find existing bug reports that match what they just saw before filing a new one.

Who's using it: Aaliyah Brooks, a QA tester on the console certification team for an open-world co-op game. She files about 15 bugs a day and is measured partly on her duplicate rate.

What they're doing right now: During a four-player co-op session on build 0.48.2117 she hit a crash: opening the world map during a rainstorm while a teammate was fast-traveling. She has the crash dump ID and a 40-second clip. Before filing, she describes it in her own words and wants likely matches back. Some candidates are the same crash under different wording, some are similar map crashes fixed two builds ago, and some may be a regression. She has to decide whether to add her repro to an existing report, reopen a closed one or file a new one.

Notable candidates: GW-31877 'Map crash during storms' (fixed in 0.47.2090, same signature, 12 duplicates); GW-33402 'Client freeze when host fast travels while map open' (open, PC only, no signature); GW-33519 'Weather overlay flicker on map' (open, S4, no crash). Also 14 other reports since build 0.46 mention 'map' and 'rain'. Her session: tester ID QA-0217, devkit PS5-DK-44.

Build it as a working web app, opened in the state that person would see at that moment. No backend: use realistic mock data (no lorem ipsum, no placeholder names), and make the interactive parts actually work client-side.

Use whatever framework and tooling you like. When you're done there must be a static production build in ./out with ./out/index.html as the entry point. It will be served from the root of a plain static file server (no rewrites, no server code) and viewed in a desktop browser at 1440×900.
